changelog:
- Initial release of seo-drift: monitor, baseline, compare, and track SEO-critical elements over time.
- Supports three main commands: baseline, compare, and history for any given URL.
- Captures and stores 12 essential SEO components, including title, meta, canonicals, robots, headings, schema, Open Graph tags, Core Web Vitals, status code, and HTML/schema hashes.
- Provides detailed diff reports with 17 comparison rules across three severity levels (CRITICAL, WARNING, INFO).
- All data stored locally in SQLite with strict security: validated URL fetching and parameterized queries.
- Includes automated error handling and cross-skill recommendations when issues are detected.
summary: SEO drift monitoring: capture baselines of SEO-critical elements, detect changes, and track regressions over time. Git for SEO: baseline, diff, and track changes to your on-page SEO. Use when user says "SEO drift", "baseline", "track changes", "did anything break", "SEO regression", "compare SEO", "before and after", "monitor SEO changes", or "deployment check".
